proves.claim: After an item lands, its clean builder seat and item folder with no live claim are removed within one maintenance cycle, and a pool spare stays.

cli.io-worktree-maintenance-landed-seat..why: Without it, finished seats stay forever and every Git command walks them all.

proves.claim: A landed or withdrawn item seat with uncommitted changes is kept and named in the maintenance log, once per set of dirty paths.

cli.io-worktree-maintenance-landed-seat..why: Without it, a regression that removes uncommitted work, or hides why a seat stayed, would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A seat holding a live claim on another item is never removed by the maintenance cycle or by landed-seat.js directly.

cli.io-worktree-maintenance-landed-seat..why: Without it, a regression that removes a seat mid-build would pass unnoticed.
